name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
description: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) provides B2C commerce APIs (SCAPI and OCAPI) to manage storefronts, products, shopper data, baskets, and orders.
primary_blocker: Salesforce Commerce Cloud requires an enterprise account/license and proper partner/admin provisioning to access production/sandbox API environments.

evidence.claim: Access B2C Commerce data (such as product and shopper data) and functionality (such as baskets and orders) through secure and well-defined API methods.
The B2C Commerce API (SCAPI) is a set of RESTful APIs for building storefronts, merchant tools, and integrations on the B2C Commerce platform.
The official Model Context Protocol adapter for Salesforce Commerce Cloud (B2C) exists on GitHub.

notes: Offers comprehensive APIs (SCAPI / OCAPI) along with official client SDKs and community/official Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
